name: Smart home
author: Lichtspiel
description: Switches Home Assistant scenes or calls webhooks when playback starts, pauses and stops: dim the lights for a movie, lights back on afterwards. Enter the Home Assistant address and a long-lived access token (your profile in Home Assistant → Security), then one rule per room under "rules": {"name": "Living room", "players": ["Samsung"], "users": [], "types": ["movie", "episode"], "play": "scene.movie", "pause": "scene.pause", "stop": "scene.lights_on"}. "players" are parts of the player's name (empty = every player; the admin's panel under Settings lists the players seen), "users" names people (empty = everyone), "types" the kinds of title (empty = all). An action is a scene, script or automation (scene.x, script.x, automation.x), a Home Assistant webhook (webhook:id) or any http(s):// address, which gets the event as JSON. Each person can switch it off for themselves under Settings.
